findings.title: M365 Token Spray and Replay Campaign Compromises Business Email Accounts - Huntress original report
findings.summary_md: Huntress reported a ten-week adversary-in-the-middle token-replay campaign against Microsoft 365 from July 14 to September 22, 2026. The attackers replayed stolen session tokens after MFA had completed, achieving 497 successful sign-ins across 97 accounts at 79 organizations. The report lists German hosting IP blocks (193.26.115[.]221, 193.26.115[.]199) and notes fake Entra device registrations. It is the earliest authoritative disclosure, dated October 22, 2026.
